files.patch:
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
-# Generate and upload real Code Scanning analyses for immutable source-head and prospective-merge SHAs.
-# The local SARIF artifact is retained separately for independent review.
+# Run real CodeQL queries for immutable source-head and prospective-merge SHAs.
+# Default setup owns Code Scanning uploads. GitHub rejects advanced-configuration
+# uploads while it is enabled; retain this lane's exact-source SARIF separately.
 name: CodeQL exact-source analysis and SARIF retention
 on:
   push:
@@ -41,11 +42,20 @@ jobs:
         shell: bash
         env:
           EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
           SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
           test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
+          identity="$RUNNER_TEMP/codeql-identity/${{ matrix.language }}/${{ matrix.source }}"
+          mkdir -p "$identity"
+          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA")
+          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
+            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA")
+          fi
+          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$identity/source-before.json"
           printf 'CODEQL_EVENT_SHA=%s CODEQL_SOURCE_SHA=%s CODEQL_SOURCE_KIND=%s CODEQL_LANGUAGE=%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$SOURCE_KIND" '${{ matrix.language }}'
       - name: Initialize pinned official CodeQL
         uses: github/codeql-action/init@1fc58d04a4d4374f921bdac573c3811c240f9c26 # v4.39.2
@@ -60,11 +70,12 @@ jobs:
           output: ${{ runner.temp }}/codeql-results/${{ matrix.language }}/${{ matrix.source }}
           ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.source == 'head' && format('refs/pull/{0}/head', github.event.pull_request.number) || github.ref }}
           sha: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
-          upload: always
+          upload: never
       - name: Verify generated SARIF is present and parseable
+        if: always() && steps.codeql.outcome != 'skipped'
         shell: bash
         env:
-          SARIF_DIR: ${{ steps.codeql.outputs.sarif-output }}
+          SARIF_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/codeql-results/${{ matrix.language }}/${{ matrix.source }}
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           python3 - "$SARIF_DIR" <<'PY'
@@ -79,10 +90,30 @@ jobs:
                   raise SystemExit(f'CODEQL_SARIF_INVALID:{path.name}')
           print(f'CODEQL_SARIF_FILES={len(files)} CODEQL_LANGUAGE=${{ matrix.language }}')
           PY
+      - name: Verify analyzed source stayed unchanged
+        if: always() && steps.codeql.outcome != 'skipped'
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
+          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
+          SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          identity="$RUNNER_TEMP/codeql-identity/${{ matrix.language }}/${{ matrix.source }}"
+          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_CANDIDATE_SHA")
+          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
+            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE_SHA" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA")
+          fi
+          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$identity/source-after.json"
+          cmp "$identity/source-before.json" "$identity/source-after.json"
       - name: Retain exact-source local SARIF for independent review
+        if: always()
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
         with:
           name: codeql-sarif-${{ matrix.language }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ github.sha }}
-          path: ${{ steps.codeql.outputs.sarif-output }}/
+          path: |
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/codeql-results/${{ matrix.language }}/${{ matrix.source }}/
+            ${{ runner.temp }}/codeql-identity/${{ matrix.language }}/${{ matrix.source }}/
           if-no-files-found: error
           retention-days: 14
